title: A rotated shape keeps its rotation when you move or resize it
goal: User 2026-09-26: 'I rotate a rectangle. Then I move it or scale it and it loses its rotation.' Work lost on the most basic edit there is; Photoshop and every editor keep rotation through move and scale. Not yet known whether it happens on a plain picture, only on a video (where moves and scales can write keyframes that may not carry the rotation), or both; reproduce every case before fixing.
acceptance: Reproduced first with walks at Next defaults: rotate a rectangle 30 degrees, then move it by dragging, by arrow keys, and by the panel; then resize it from a corner handle, an edge handle, with Shift, and by the panel; on a screenshot document and on a recording, with and without keys already on the layer; record which cases drop the rotation

Core tests (PhotonzCore, written first) for every failing case: move and resize preserve rotation exactly; resize handles act in the shape's own rotated frame (dragging a corner of a rotated rectangle resizes along its rotated sides, as Photoshop's free transform does)
On a layer with keys, a move or resize at a new moment writes position/scale keys that carry the current rotation, never a rotation of zero; an unkeyed rotation stays static
The same holds for every shape kind (ellipse, line, arrow, path, text, image, sticker, component, group) and for multi-selection
Undo restores the exact pre-edit rotation
Walk photographs a rotated rectangle before and after each move and resize, on a picture and on a video

log.note: Reproduced 2026-09-26 with throwaway walks at Next defaults (rectangle turned 20/45 deg, then body drag, arrows, corner, edge, Shift corner, panel X, panel W; on a blank picture and on the sample recording; with Position, Scale and Rotation keyed). The stored model kept the angle in every unkeyed case (harness tree now prints 'turned N°'). Two real bugs: (1) the drag sprite was the finished turned drawing cut to the upright box plus effect padding, so mid-drag the turned rectangle showed its corners sliced off flat (photographed with drag hold); turning an already-turned layer clipped the same way; resizing a turned photo would have stretched the baked-in turn along screen axes (shear). (2) With Rotation keyed, the canvas edit was applied to the STORED layer while foldEditIntoKeys compared against the POSE, so a move/resize at a moment where keys had turned the layer wrote the stored angle back as a new Rotation key (core test: keys 0@1s 30@3s, move at 5s -> angle 0 and a third key).

Fix: Layer.dragSpritePadding (core, tested) pads the sprite by renderBounds ∪ turnedReach; beginLayerDrag uses it. Layer.resizeScalesUniformly is false for a rotation or skew, so a turned layer's resize re-renders live instead of stretching the sprite. PhotonzDocument.editPosedForCanvas (core, tested) puts the pose on the layer before the hand's edit, then folds into keys; EditorState.foldingIntoKeys calls it. Tests: DragSpritePaddingTests, TurnedDragSpriteTests (render: sprite ink 20000 at 20/45/90/135 deg; failed with old padding, lost up to half), ResizePreviewScalingTests (+2), RotationSurvivesMoveAndResizeTests (every kind: rectangle, ellipse, line, arrow, path, text, image, group; keyed place/size/turn; turn back to stored angle still keys; Escape leaves nothing). Adversarial: Photoshop keeps the turn through move and Free Transform scale and resizes along the turned sides; ours already resized in the turned frame. Stickers and components are a picture and a group in the model, covered by image and group. Left rough: undo with Position and Size open takes two steps (filed undo-after-a-drag-puts-a-shape-back-where-it-was, p2, reproduced); drawn angle at 2s between keys 20@1s and 0@3s read 4 deg, not investigated (ease/playhead position, not a lost turn).
